summary.text: Chad Reichard is a Republican member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives from District 90, which he has represented since December 2024, and he is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot; Ballotpedia lists him as the only candidate in the general election.
His career experience includes work in government and as an insurance agent.

paragraphs.text: Reichard was born in Chambersburg, Pennsylvania, graduated from Waynesboro Area High School in 2009, earned a bachelor's degree from American University in 2012, and received a graduate degree from Penn State University in 2022.
Ballotpedia lists his affiliations as St. Mary's Episcopal Church, George Washington Lodge #143 F&AM, the Franklin County Farm Bureau and the Franklin County Republican Committee.
